title: Pure Triamid
summary: Triamid cards only, with generic Links and staples. Triamid is a Rock deck built around three Field Spells that trigger when they leave the field. Every Triamid monster can send your Triamid Field Spell to the GY on the opponent's turn and activate a different one from the Deck. Triamid Cruiser then searches a Triamid monster, Triamid Fortress recovers one, and Triamid Kingolem summons one from the hand. Triamid Hunter grants an extra Rock Normal Summon while a Field Spell is up, and Triamid Master destroys a Set card. Triamid Sphinx summons itself when a Triamid card is destroyed and grows with each Field Spell name in the GY. Triamid Loading, the newest card, searches a Triamid Spell/Trap every time a Field Spell is placed and summons a Triamid from the Deck when your Rock is destroyed.
